fine_grid_study.interpretation: All six unchanged thresholds fail during reconstruction. Thresholds 0.20/0.25/0.30 require forbidden cells for manifold repair; thresholds 0.35/0.40/0.50 are disconnected. No solid passed the prerequisite geometry gate, so no subsequent manufacturing/mass/FEA acceptance is claimed. No manual repair or changed keepout was used.
